craft_notes: Sthāyin: liṅga-pūjā unit 7. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Therefore in secret śāstras: which mantras — these the wise — outside
not should install ever, especially manifest-formed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tasmādrahasyaśāstreṣu ye mantrāstānbudho bahiḥ na pratiṣṭhāpayejjātu viśeṣādvyaktarūpiṇaḥ
